description: Call this FIRST. Returns the whole flow in one response: the exact order of tools to rent a VPS and to run code in a sandbox (with example arguments), the only human step (paying a crypto checkout_url), auth rules (one account, reusable token), common errors with fixes, limits — and `you_are_here`: if you are authenticated, your balance, servers and the next call to make. Every other tool response also carries `next_steps`, and every error carries `error.fix` + `error.next`. Requires: nothing. Call this first.
